src: solid monochromatic foreground rectangles ordered left-to-right
dst: packed upper wide slots and lower tall slots in the same left-to-right order
match_cond: rank(s) == rank(d) for both the upper and lower slot sequences
transform: paint each rectangle twice: min(h,w) by max(h,w) top-aligned in the upper band, and max(h,w) by min(h,w) bottom-aligned in the lower band, with one background column between slots
grid_shape: height 10; width is the sum of max(h,w) over source rectangles plus one separator column between consecutive rectangles
